en.headline: Public schools cut record 126 Primary One classes for new school year
en.dek: The latest Primary School Profiles show a net drop of 8 per cent; Kwai Tsing lost the most classes, followed by Tuen Mun and Eastern district.
body: Hong Kong public primary schools have reduced Primary One classes by a record 126 for the 2026-27 academic year amid a shrinking student population, according to the newly published Primary School Profiles.

The guide, compiled by the Committee on Home-School Co-operation, recorded a fall from 1,558 Primary One classes in 2025-26 to 1,432 this year. Of more than 440 aided and government primary schools, 121 cut a total of 144 classes while 17 expanded by 18, producing the net reduction. Kwai Tsing was hardest hit with 17 fewer classes, followed by Tuen Mun and Eastern district with 13 each.

Fifteen schools received no Primary One allocation and face possible merger or closure. Sector representatives said the contraction reflects the sharp drop in local births since 2020 and warned further cuts are likely in coming years as the school-age population continues to decline.

zh.headline: 今學年小一淨減126班創紀錄 葵青成縮班重災區
zh.dek: 《小學概覽2026》顯示官津小學小一班數按年跌約8%；121間學校合共縮144班，15間學校派零班。
body: 隨着適齡學童減少，本港官津小學今學年小一班數淨減126班，創下紀錄。最新出版的《小學概覽2026》顯示，小一班數由上學年1,558班減至1,432班。
在超過440間官立及津貼小學中，121間合共縮減144班，另有17間擴18班。按分區計，葵青區縮班最多，共減17班；屯門及東區各減13班。另有15間學校因收生不足獲派零班小一，面對合併或停辦壓力。
教育界人士指出，縮班反映2020年以來本地出生數字急跌的影響，並預料未來數年適齡人口將繼續下降，縮班及零班學校數目或進一步上升。
